notes: GAAP city, fiscal year ended 9/30/2023. Governmental lines from the Total Governmental Funds column (p4); business-type from the Combined Utilities Fund statement (p6). Business-type receipts/disbursements totals = operating + nonoperating (no single printed total; the printed 'Total non-operating expenses' (202,282) nets interest income 3,514). Ending cash/investments from the governmental funds balance sheet (p3); no beginning cash printed. Statement 'Intergovernmental' 575,672 includes ARP Fund 70,820 (federal, p10), kept as one Total-column line. Sales tax 382,731 is broken down on the Statement of Activities (p2) into Public Safety Services Agency indebtedness 191,365 and infrastructure improvements 191,366; kept one line (already sales tax). Governmental detail: the only governmental budget schedule is a combined budgetary-basis comparison for all governmental funds (p9, Property taxes / State receipts / Local receipts groups), so detail is one line per fund column of the governmental funds statement (p4: General, Debt Service, Sales Tax) plus the nonmajor combining schedule (p10: ARP; Housing had no activity); the p9 budget schedule is not recorded (double counting). Utility detail from the combining departmental schedule (p11), department columns Electric/Water/Sewer/Sanitation; nonoperating lines and capital contributions are printed only in the Total column. Proprietary cash flows p7 (no noncapital financing section). Governmental roll: 1,582,646 + 2,083,460 - 2,097,660 + 170,581 - 170,581 = 1,568,446. Business: 2,677,272 + 1,294,373 - 1,331,382 + 70,785 = 2,711,048. Read pages 1-11 of 11
